summary: Issue #1751, lane A: reassessment under current standards of the 24 open leaves reached by expanding the cost-6 route ed7c588a to GOD_4 exists (8626f8a5) through cheapest verified supports, in the prima via motion and causal-chain core and its naming bridge. Baseline main df4909cb025d2e53fee6071a32defe9cf2721284. Read: currentness at the GOD_4 root (none of the 24 had a current assessment: 10 legacy_only, 14 none), the dossiers of all 24, context of ed7c588a, the 19 consuming argument and result records and the Lean declarations of each leaf and of the closed nodes they support; legacy attempts ab0f7e3a, f2f06fbe, f4bee7d7, 3efb2e4b, c132609d, d1d58e1e, 0b9ad38b, df5581ce, 1032961a, 0626cd3a, 0b9378da, 09f03f51, 1d0d9d70, 096c30cc, 76b347ef, 30c343f7, 4746eaa2, a330f2e5 and 75c35dd5. No new source was read. Placement: almost every route node these leaves support (c1b68c21, 1e47e6db, 96da1d33, c2880fe0, 97f5850f, f296a694, 777646a5, 0628359b, c85e8ef5, a4d3261a, 079b53bf) has its own stating claim, so the leaves are additional support options and the direct options stay. End states: defended primitive for 6b9fedc2 (on the inclusive formal-or-virtual InAct reading), 7b8b589c, 9c252f24, a7d2b839, fe09fcd0 (meaning postulate under MOTION_1), 76e0f716, 3c0b7bb3, 7c3da33e (the 2026-11-13 judgment reused), 57552dce (selection stipulation), 68172f57 and, as a moderate dispensable direct option, 3209ff59; derivable vacuously at the route's instantiation for 0181cf7b; open with a concrete blocker for b3573a61, d791628f and f03798ba (one commitment C*, kept standing-power-agent rival from Physics III.3 claim 849f4443, and a POTENCY sense gap for f03798ba), 8a22ae75 (kept per accidens objection, q.46 a.2 ad 7 reading B, claim 2e18db19; weak sibling 446e3f2a), 6a0b545c (aspect of CausesIn), 6ca87431 (kept reciprocity objection), 010988b9 (no discriminating warrant beyond a4d3261a), 962a9ed3 (ByOwnForm for concurrently sustained forms), f1a124b6 (qualified predication, partial), b3853b1b (unsettled scope, no established counterexample), 1ad18c70 (unselected calibration, transcription-only consumer fcb4b871, belongs to the modal-spine uniting-cause family) and a594d8c4 (missing same-bearer attribute or reference-fixing bridge; direct option moderate). New analyst observations, unregistered and not Lean-checked: (1) under one CausesIn and InAct reading, fbc516c1, 6b9fedc2, 4be9a4ac, c6d6379b, 6a0b545c and 67aa5b5c are jointly inconsistent, and 67aa5b5c reaches the GOD_4 root through arguments 90e85f77 and f632c6e5; (2) the respect-free consequent of 6ca87431, with 7ad36aca and 32d77f18, is inconsistent with reciprocal cross-respect moving, which is ordinary under MOTION_1; the composition a7d2b839 with lane B's e078f07b has the same consequence, matching registered statement 0566122f; (3) f03798ba with d791628f, 0628359b and an OperationOf-to-RelevantTo bridge gives b3573a61 for caused movers; (4) bypass B1: 97f5850f follows from 42890b45 and f10d5632 by subrelation accessibility, which removes 68172f57 and b3853b1b from this support; (5) bypass B2: with Moves instantiated as MovesIn, fe09fcd0 and 079b53bf exclude diagonal moving, so 0181cf7b and 99470e3f hold vacuously and f296a694 follows without the self-motion leaves, provided 079b53bf is not taken from 8035e43e. Objections: kept 6, restated 6, boundaries retained 3, exact sense gaps 6; countermodels restated as facts about single interpretations. No theorem, Challenge, claim, statement, definition, relation, closure or formal status changed. No revision is declared.
blocker: Open: the commitment C* (a mover whose being another causes is itself being moved, whenever it moves, in a respect relevant to or constituting that moving), stated as b3573a61, as f03798ba with d791628f, and as 8a22ae75, against the kept standing-power-agent rival; a non-God-indexed account of application to operation is the missing discriminator. Exact sense gaps: the aspect of CausesIn for 6a0b545c (factive versus in-progress); respect-free PriorSimply for 6ca87431 and 010988b9 under reciprocal moving (shared with lane B's e078f07b, 7ad36aca, 32d77f18 and d85de8e1); the POTENCY_1 versus retained-power sense in f03798ba; the MOTION_2 label of fe09fcd0 on a MOTION_1 route; ByOwnForm for concurrently sustained forms in 962a9ed3; formal versus virtual InAct for 6b9fedc2. For a594d8c4: same-bearer derivations of the remaining GOD_4 attributes, intellect and will among them, or a defended reference-fixing account. 1ad18c70 needs a calibration selection, and its consumer is transcription-only. Next test: fix one caused agent acting continuously on one patient in one respect and decide whether an operation-respect o exists with InPotency y o, ActualizedQuaPotential y o and RelevantTo y x r o; first register the restricted derivation of b3573a61 for caused movers from a non-God-indexed restatement of f03798ba, d791628f, 0628359b and an explicit OperationOf-to-RelevantTo bridge.

current_assessment.scope: Prima via motion and causal-chain core and its naming bridge: the 24 open leaves reached by expanding the cost-6 route ed7c588a to GOD_4 exists (8626f8a5) through cheapest verified supports. These are the act clause 6b9fedc2; the per se scope and instrument leaves 962a9ed3, 7b8b589c and b3573a61; the efficient-link leaves 9c252f24, a7d2b839 and 8a22ae75; the in-act support 6a0b545c with the self-motion branch 0181cf7b, 3209ff59 and f1a124b6; the act/potency analyses 76e0f716, 3c0b7bb3 and 7c3da33e; the operation-potency leaves f03798ba and d791628f; motion in the moved fe09fcd0; the act-priority fork 6ca87431 and 010988b9; the finite-branching leaves 68172f57, b3853b1b and 57552dce; the composer calibration 1ad18c70; and the naming bridge a594d8c4. Lane B's dependence, priority, regress and grounding leaves (including d85de8e1, f10d5632, e078f07b, 47aff057, 09b88101, 97fa3a0b, 000e1f65 and c0d99549) keep their own scope and are named only as shared dependencies. The 2026-11-13 potency/privation judgment and the 2026-11-17 relevance-bridge assessment keep their own scope.
current_assessment.assessment: Under the fixed meanings (MOTION_1; generic InAct with DISAMB-IN-ACT undecided; adopted POTENCY_1; strong per se reading; MovesIn, CausesIn and EfficientlyCausesIn kept apart; respect-free PriorSimply; SELF_MOTION_1 and SELF_MOTION_3 kept apart; GOD_2 and GOD_4 kept apart; one fixed context), the motion core is a coherent, positively motivated conditional route. Every route node it expands except 74eb9113 and 27d15954 is also stated by a source claim, so the leaves are added support options and those direct options remain. Ten leaves are well supported as sourced principles, meaning postulates, conceptual articulations or selection stipulations: 6b9fedc2 (on the inclusive formal-or-virtual act reading), 7b8b589c, 9c252f24, a7d2b839, fe09fcd0, 76e0f716, 3c0b7bb3, 7c3da33e, 57552dce and 68172f57. One, 0181cf7b, is derivable vacuously at the route's instantiation. 3209ff59 is a moderate direct option. 962a9ed3, 6a0b545c, 3209ff59, f1a124b6 and b3853b1b are dispensable through stated nodes or the unregistered bypasses B1 and B2. The contested load is one commitment, C*, stated as b3573a61, as f03798ba with d791628f, and as 8a22ae75. The absolute First-Way conclusion and the first-being bridge rest on it. The standing-power-agent rival (Physics III.3, claim 849f4443; q.46 a.2 ad 7 reading B, claim 2e18db19) is kept. Without C*, the relative conclusion remains available through result e05d2976; beyond its stated premises, its contested load is the regress 226c38f6, shared with lane B. Two newly exposed sense gaps affect support options rather than the stated f296a694 and a4d3261a: the aspect of CausesIn (6a0b545c is inconsistent with 67aa5b5c and the core prima via premises under one reading), and respect-free simple priority under reciprocal moving (6ca87431, and a7d2b839 composed with lane B's e078f07b). The second bears on every route node that uses respect-free PriorSimply. The naming bridge a594d8c4 is a defensible provisional identification of moderate strength, not independent evidence for the remaining GOD_4 attributes; its attribute or reference-fixing bridge is open. Overall: moderate for the absolute conclusion; well supported, apart from the regress, for the relative conclusion. Kept objections: 6. Restated: 6. Boundaries retained: 3. Exact sense gaps: 6. Countermodels are facts about single interpretations. These are first grades for all 24 except 3c0b7bb3 and 7c3da33e, whose 2026-11-13 judgment is reused. No earlier weighting is changed and no revision is declared; nothing is established, defeated or closed.
current_assessment.next_test: Fix one caused agent that acts continuously on one patient in one respect (fire heating wood), under MOTION_1 and adopted POTENCY_1. Decide whether an operation-respect o exists with InPotency y o, ActualizedQuaPotential y o and RelevantTo y x r o, that is, whether a non-God-indexed account of application to operation exists. Formally, first register the restricted derivation of b3573a61 for caused movers from a non-God-indexed restatement of f03798ba, d791628f, the stated 0628359b and an explicit OperationOf-to-RelevantTo bridge, so that C* is one certified commitment. A positive account upgrades b3573a61, d791628f and f03798ba together. An account on which steady transient action adds no actuality to the agent leaves the absolute conclusion on the source-of-esse route of the 2026-11-17 section, which lacks the local moving edge. Formal follow-ups: certify the six-premise CausesIn inconsistency and the reciprocity inconsistency; register bypasses B1 and B2; record strong_version_needed on e3874506 or build a weak route through 446e3f2a.
